markers.TAURIKIT:AUTH_ERRORS:
#[error("Auth provider error: {0}")]
    AuthProvider(String),

    #[error("Token expired or revoked")]
    TokenExpired,

    #[error("Auth denied by user")]
    AuthDenied,

    #[error("Auth code expired, please try again")]
    AuthExpired,

    #[error("Store error: {0}")]
    Store(String),
markers.TAURIKIT:AUTH_STATE:
pub auth_token: Option<String>,
    pub username: Option<String>,
    pub avatar_url: Option<String>,
    pub http_client: reqwest::Client,
markers.TAURIKIT:AUTH_STATE_DEFAULTS:
auth_token: None,
            username: None,
            avatar_url: None,
            http_client: reqwest::Client::builder()
                .user_agent("{{APP_SLUG}}")
                .build()
                .expect("failed to build http client"),
markers.TAURIKIT:STORE_AUTH_SETTERS:
setAuth: (auth: AuthStatus) => void;
  setAuthLoading: (loading: boolean) => void;
markers.TAURIKIT:STORE_AUTH_DEFAULTS:
auth: { authenticated: false, username: null, avatarUrl: null },
  authLoading: true,
markers.TAURIKIT:STORE_AUTH_SETTER_IMPLS:
setAuth: (auth) => set({ auth }),
  setAuthLoading: (authLoading) => set({ authLoading }),
